title: House in mallworld?
content: Does anyone visit the inside of a house that has a double staircase that leads up to a 2nd floor (it may even have a third) and it’s almost like an old Victorian style home? There is a bathroom that has a corner tub and it connects one room to another? And there always feels like one room in the house has someone really sick on bed rest like basically dying in there so you don’t go there often?? Just me?😅
